issues.quote: supplies every method the interface lists, or when it derives from a class that does; if a listed method is missing, the code does not compile.
issues.text: Claim 1 carries the condition 'every member that has no default body'; the bullet drops it, and section 5 then says an interface can give a method a default body, so the two sentences disagree. Scratch build SDK 10.0.300: 'UsesDefault : IWithDefault { }' compiles although it supplies no 'Send' (the interface gives it a body); only bodiless members trigger CS0535 (interfaces.md l.86 '(unless the interface provides a default implementation)').
issues.fix: Replace the bullet with: "implements — a class implements an interface when it names the interface after its `:` and supplies every method the interface lists without a body, or when it derives from a class that does; if one of those is missing, the code does not compile."

issues.quote: Without either, the interface is one more file to keep in step with its class.
issues.text: The two sentences before it hedge with 'usually', as outline item 4 does; this one makes testing and a boundary the only possible reasons, so every other single-implementer interface is declared pure overhead. Stated as fact with no condition and no supporting document under versions.yaml. Quiz q5 does not depend on the exhaustive form.
issues.fix: Replace the sentence with: "Without such a reason, the interface is one more file to keep in step with its class."
